newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Rep. Fox declared winner in narrow race.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Rep. Fox declared winner in narrow race.

text.p: Republican U.S. Representative Jon Fox won re-election to a second term by 84 votes over Democratic challenger Joseph Hoeffel, according to official results released Thursday.

Joseph Pasarella, director of voting services in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, told Reuters the official count showed Fox won with 120,304 votes against 120,220 for Hoeffel in the contest to represent Pennsylvania's 13th congressional district.
The tabulation boosted Fox's lead from an unofficial 10 votes after the Nov. 5 election.
"There were some precincts that did not get us their absentee results on election night," Pasarella said in explaining the increased margin for Fox.
Fox claimed victory Wednesday on the basis of reports from campaign workers who observed the tabulation.
Hoeffel, a Montgomery County commissioner, later conceded defeat. "It was certainly a successful campaign, except we didn't win," he told a news conference. "I congratulate Jon for his victory."
